title: Advanced Conditionals without IF
completion_message: ¡Excelente! En los niveles más altos del inglés, prescindimos de la palabra 'If' para usar alternativas más elegantes. Expresiones como 'Provided that', 'Unless' o la inversión condicional 'Had we known' otorgan a tu discurso un tono ejecutivo y literario inigualable.

parts.visual:
Alternativas a 'If': 

1. Provided (that) / Providing (that) / On the condition that: 
- Significado: Solo si / Siempre y cuando. 
Ej: We will sign the contract provided that you lower the price. 

2. Unless: 
- Significado: A menos que (If not). 
Ej: Unless we receive the funds by Friday, the project will be cancelled. 

3. As long as: 
- Significado: Siempre que / Mientras. 
Ej: You can work from home as long as you meet your deadlines.
parts.audio: Welcome to Advanced Conditionals. In high-level English, we often replace 'If' with more elegant alternatives. Number 1: Provided that, Providing that, or On the condition that. These mean 'only if'. For example: We will sign the contract provided that you lower the price. Number 2: Unless. This means 'if not' or 'except if'. For example: Unless we receive the funds by Friday, the project will be cancelled. Number 3: As long as. This means 'provided that' or 'while'. For example: You can work from home as long as you meet your deadlines.

parts.visual:
Inversión Condicional (Conditional Inversion): 
En inglés formal, podemos eliminar 'If' e invertir el sujeto y el verbo auxiliar en los condicionales 1, 2 y 3. 

Condicional 1 (Should): 
Normal: If you need help, call me. 
Inversión: SHOULD YOU need help, call me. 

Condicional 2 (Were to / Were): 
Normal: If I were the CEO, I would change the policy. 
Inversión: WERE I the CEO, I would change the policy. 

Condicional 3 (Had): 
Normal: If we had known about the risk, we wouldn't have invested. 
Inversión: HAD WE KNOWN about the risk, we wouldn't have invested.
parts.audio: Conditional Inversion. In formal English, we can eliminate 'If' and invert the subject and auxiliary verb in conditionals 1, 2, and 3. For the First Conditional, we use 'Should'. Normal: If you need help, call me. Inverted: SHOULD YOU need help, call me. For the Second Conditional, we use 'Were'. Normal: If I were the CEO, I would change the policy. Inverted: WERE I the CEO, I would change the policy. For the Third Conditional, we use 'Had'. Normal: If we had known about the risk, we wouldn't have invested. Inverted: HAD WE KNOWN about the risk, we wouldn't have invested.

questions.question: Normal: If you require further assistance, please let me know. -> Inversion: ____ you require further assistance, please let me know.
questions.explanation: Inversión de primer condicional: Should you require.

questions.question: Normal: If they had offered a better salary, I would have accepted the job. -> Inversion: ____ they offered a better salary, I would have accepted the job.
questions.explanation: Inversión de tercer condicional: Had they offered.

questions.question: Normal: If I were in your position, I would resign immediately. -> Inversion: ____ I in your position, I would resign immediately.
questions.explanation: Inversión de segundo condicional: Were I in your position.

questions.question: We are happy to proceed with the merger ____ that the CEO steps down. (Siempre y cuando).
questions.explanation: Provided (that) = siempre y cuando / a condición de que.

questions.question: ____ you pay the invoice by tomorrow, we will have to suspend your account. (A menos que).
____ it rain tomorrow, the outdoor event will be cancelled. (Inversión condicional).
questions.explanation: Should it rain = If it rains.

questions.question: You can take the company car ____ long as you return it with a full tank of gas.
questions.explanation: As long as = siempre y cuando.

questions.question: ____ we not invested in that startup, we would be bankrupt now. (Inversión).
questions.explanation: Had we not invested = If we hadn't invested.

questions.question: I will give you the discount on the ____ that you sign a two-year contract.
questions.explanation: On the condition that = con la condición de que.

questions.question: ____ she to find out the truth, she would be furious. (Inversión de If she were to find out).
questions.explanation: Were she to find out = If she were to find out.

questions.question: We cannot guarantee delivery by Friday ____ you upgrade to express shipping. (A menos que).
____ I known the meeting was cancelled, I wouldn't have woken up so early.
questions.explanation: Had I known = If I had known.

questions.question: ____ the alarm sound, please proceed to the nearest exit immediately.
questions.explanation: Should the alarm sound = If the alarm sounds.

questions.question: ____ that we secure the funding, we will launch the app next quarter. (Suponiendo/Siempre que).
____ they agreed to our terms, the deal would have been closed yesterday.
questions.explanation: Had they agreed = If they had agreed.

questions.question: They agreed to invest $1 million, ____ that they get a seat on the board.
questions.explanation: Provided that = a condición de que.

questions.question: ____ it not been for your help, we would have failed. (Si no hubiera sido por tu ayuda).
questions.explanation: Had it not been for = If it hadn't been for.

questions.question: I wouldn't accept that job ____ they paid me a million dollars. (Incluso si / Ni aunque).
questions.explanation: Even if = incluso si / ni aunque.

questions.question: ____ there be any delays, please notify the client immediately. (Inversión).
questions.explanation: Should there be = If there are/should be.

questions.question: I don't care ____ you come or not; I'm going to the party anyway. (Si... o no).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra que completa el condicional.

questions.question: ____ you need help, call me. (Si de casualidad - Inversión)
____ we known, we wouldn't have gone. (Si hubiéramos sabido - Inversión)
____ I the CEO, I would change it. (Si yo fuera - Inversión)
I'll go ____ that you pay. (Siempre y cuando)
I won't go ____ you pay. (A menos que)
____ long as you pay, I'll go. (Mientras)
On the ____ that you pay. (Con la condición)
____ it not been for him, we would have lost. (Si no hubiera sido por - Inversión)
I'll do it ____ if it's hard. (Incluso si)
I don't know ____ to go or not. (Si... o no)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la estructura condicional correcta.

If you need help, call me.
Would you need help, call me.
Should he need help, call me.
